decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display, it remains very close to the firm's core POS display offer and supports its problem-solving, service-led positioning.
The pegboard-back cardboard display is still a standard and useful variant within the firm's established display range, so it is worth retaining.
The wooden display pallet is more peripheral to a paper-based display specialist, and in a flat market the firm is likely to refocus resources on its stronger cardboard core and new developments.
Although more niche because of its media focus, this cardboard quarter-pallet display still fits the firm's manufacturing capabilities and customer base closely enough to keep.
